an9.72:1.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho .
an9.72:1.4: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu kāmesu avītarāgo hoti avigatachando avigatapemo avigatapipāso avigatapariḷāho avigatataṇho, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya.
an9.72:1.5: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, ayaṃ paṭhamo cetaso vinibandho.
an9.72:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave bhikkhu kāye avītarāgo hoti …pe…
an9.72:2.3: yāvadatthaṃ udarāvadehakaṃ bhuñjitvā seyyasukhaṃ passasukhaṃ middhasukhaṃ anuyutto viharati …pe…
an9.72:2.4: aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati, imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro vā’ti.
an9.72:2.5: yo so bhikkhave bhikkhu aññataraṃ devanikāyaṃ paṇidhāya brahmacariyaṃ carati imināhaṃ sīlena vā vatena vā tapena vā brahmacariyena vā devo vā bhavissāmi devaññataro cāti, tassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya, sātaccāya padhānāya.
an9.72:2.6: yassa cittaṃ na namati ātappāya anuyogāya sātaccāya padhānāya, ayaṃ pañcamo cetaso vinibandho.
an9.72:2.7: ime kho bhikkhave, pañca cetaso vinibandhānaṃ.
an9.72:3.1: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave pañcannaṃ cetaso vinibandhānaṃ pahānāya
